releases.title: SKiDL 3.0.0 wheels
releases.notes: Wheels of skidl 3.0.0, kinet2pcb 1.1.4 and hierplace 1.1.0, for rules_netlist's SKiDL toolchain (issue #9). PyPI has only sdists of these. Built as tools/mirror/README.md says (README.md, SKiDL wheels): skidl-3.0.0-py3-none-any.whl from https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/s/skidl/skidl-3.0.0.tar.gz (sha256 265f2b188a87c4e7190a46e08ac76e8e010b00232aef5093f5d801e062885b0e); kinet2pcb-1.1.4-py2.py3-none-any.whl from https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/k/kinet2pcb/kinet2pcb-1.1.4.tar.gz (sha256 9374a09ba58f64895b5e47c972b20315d624e06eec48925df26a308e2746f661); hierplace-1.1.0-py3-none-any.whl from https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/h/hierplace/hierplace-1.1.0.tar.gz (sha256 1386717bb9e6759d9b319013d6edd0f568b717f834e29d9d804ab5cc4c0d0ad0).
